notes: Version 2.11 corrects the Bell registry entry after an independent audit found the published Bell paper's central implication false: non-injectivity of an observable projection does not by itself obstruct Bell factorisation, refuted by a finite Bell-local countermodel, and its PR-box construction has empty support. A new companion paper, BellNoGo, proves the general no-go theorem and identifies the correct obstruction (absence of a setting-independent global coupling across measurement contexts); it is added to the abstract's quantum-structure paragraph, the paper inventory table, and the interactive dependency graph (new node and edge), and the paper count (116 -> 117). The static TikZ figure is not yet updated with a BellNoGo node; flagged as a follow-up.
